chunks: And the Messenger of Allah, peace be upon him and his family, said:
"Whoever is overly cautious about his garment in his salat (prayer), then he has not clothed himself for Allah."

key_terms.اتَّقَى: was cautious or guarded himself excessively
key_terms.لِلَّهِ: for Allah, in devotion to Him

ai.seo_question: What does the hadith mean about being preoccupied with one's clothing during salat (prayer)?
ai.summary: This hadith teaches that in salat (prayer), a person's concern should be directed toward Allah rather than excessive preoccupation with his clothing. It emphasizes sincerity and inward attentiveness in worship over outward self-consciousness.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.619 - The Messenger of Allah (sw) said:
"Whoever is overly cautious about his clothing during prayer (focusing excessively on keeping it clean or arranged), is not truly clothing himself for Allah (swt)”.
